architecture: PPARC-SHARP: prediction-powered residual estimator + residual-variance Neyman extension + studentized finite-population GREG tail certification
important_statistical_note: SHARP tail certification is studentized design-based finite-population inference, not the worst-case nonasymptotic Bernstein-Serfling certificate used in PPARC stage 1.
primary_bottleneck_fixed: replace worst-case residual-range concentration with observed residual-variance design inference only for PPARC-unresolved cases
stop_rule: If terminal_contract_satisfied=true, freeze. If false, inspect SHARP_UNRESOLVED_CASES.csv; do not add an unlimited fallback.
tail_interval: stratified design-based finite-population variance + Satterthwaite t, action-specific one-sided 95% bounds
